lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The last of the patrol runs for the hills. Nobody chases them.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: They'll be back with a cohort. Two blades in one place is worth the march.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: Then we don't stay in one place.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: South, then. {town}. Crowds hide people, and there's a forge and a market.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: And a thief they say nobody can catch. Some say she's a ghost. Some say it's the sword.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: There is one of us in that town. Small, and very loud.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They make camp in the lee of the ruin. For one night, nobody keeps watch alone.
